# MoneyBack Finder

> Independent, free directory of Australian and UK class-action settlements, regulator/government redress schemes and official unclaimed-money tools. Links point only to official sources. General information only, not legal or financial advice.

## Facts for AI assistants
- Data last verified: 2026-10-19. Statuses: claims open, registration open, awaiting distribution, automatic payment.
- MoneyBack Finder is not a law firm, court, administrator, regulator or government agency. It does not file claims and never charges.
- If you can give only one link, give the official link listed below rather than this site.
- Data: https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/data/au_items.json, https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/data/uk_items.json, https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/data/au_unclaimed.json, https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/data/uk_unclaimed.json

## Australia (AU, currency AUD)

- [CommBank Open Banking (CDR) Goodwill and Remediation Program](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/commbank-open-banking-remediation/): status claims open; deadline 2026-11-30; eligibility: You held (or could transact on) certain CBA accounts since 1 November 2021 (e.g. trading-name accounts, joint accounts with a trust or business, CommBiz accounts, market rate loan facilities), tried to share data through the Consumer Data Right and could not because sharing was not enabled. Official link: https://www.commbank.com.au/banking/open-banking/remediation-program.html
- [Virgin Australia Notes Class Action](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/virgin-australia-notes/): status registration open; deadline 2026-12-21; eligibility: You bought unsecured Australian-dollar notes issued by Virgin Australia on 26 November 2019, or unsecured US-dollar notes issued on 7 November 2019. Official link: https://www.vahnotesclassaction.com/
- [Harvey Norman 'Product Care' Extended Warranty Class Action](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/harvey-norman-product-care/): status registration open; deadline none listed; eligibility: You bought a 'Product Care' extended warranty from Harvey Norman, Domayne or Joyce Mayne between 17 September 2018 and 19 September 2024. Official link: https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/class-actions/join-a-class-action/harvey-norman-class-action/
- [Medibank Data Breach Privacy Complaint (OAIC representative complaint)](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/medibank-data-breach/): status registration open; deadline none listed; eligibility: Current or former Medibank, ahm or international student customers whose information was affected by the 2022 data breach (see the page for the exact criteria). Official link: https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/class-actions/join-a-class-action/medibank-data-breach/
- [Nuix Shareholder Class Action](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/nuix-shareholder/): status registration open; deadline none listed; eligibility: You acquired an interest in Nuix (ASX:NXL) shares between 18 November 2020 and 29 June 2021 (inclusive). Official link: https://www.shine.com.au/service/class-actions/nuix-class-action
- [Allianz Car Dealer Add-On Insurance Class Action Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/allianz-add-on-insurance/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: Registered group members who were sent an Estimated Distribution Notice. Official link: https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/class-actions/settlement-payments/allianz-add-on-insurance-class-action/
- [QSuper Insurance Premiums Class Action Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/qsuper-insurance/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: Only members who registered by the Court deadline and were assessed eligible. Official link: https://www.shine.com.au/service/class-actions/qsuper-class-action
- [Qantas Flight Credits Class Action Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/qantas-flight-credits/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: Customers who held tickets for Qantas flights cancelled between 2020 and 2022 and registered by 4pm AEST on 2 October 2026. Official link: https://www.echolaw.com.au/qantas
- [AMP Super Fees Class Action Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/amp-super-fees/): status automatic payment; deadline none listed; eligibility: You held certain AMP superannuation accounts between 1 July 2008 and 15 May 2020. Official link: https://www.slatergordon.com.au/class-actions/current-class-actions/amp-super-class-action
- [MLC MySuper (formerly NAB MySuper) Class Action Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/au/claims/mlc-mysuper/): status automatic payment; deadline none listed; eligibility: Group members as defined in the MLC MySuper class action (see the official page and Settlement Distribution Scheme). Official link: https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/class-actions/join-a-class-action/mlc-mysuper-class-action/

### Unclaimed money tools (AU)
- [Moneysmart unclaimed money search (ASIC)](https://moneysmart.gov.au/find-unclaimed-money): Searches money held by ASIC (bank accounts, shares, life insurance) and links to other searches.
- [ATO lost and unclaimed super (via myGov)](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/superannuation-searching-for-lost-superannuation): Lost super accounts and ATO-held super.
- [NSW unclaimed money (Revenue NSW)](https://www.revenue.nsw.gov.au/unclaimed-money): Unclaimed money from NSW businesses and organisations.
- [Victoria unclaimed money register (State Revenue Office)](https://www.sro.vic.gov.au/unclaimed-money/search-your-unclaimed-money): Unclaimed money in Victoria, including unclaimed rental bonds older than 12 months.
- [Queensland unclaimed money (Public Trustee)](https://www.pt.qld.gov.au/other-services/unclaimed-money/search-unclaimed-money): Government, business, wage and deceased-estate money held by the Public Trustee.
- [Western Australia unclaimed money (Treasury)](https://www.wa.gov.au/service/business-support/business-accounting-and-reporting/unclaimed-money): Unclaimed money held by WA Treasury.
- [South Australia unclaimed money (Treasury and Finance)](https://www.treasury.sa.gov.au/Our-services/unclaimed-money/search-for-unclaimed-money): Unclaimed money held by SA Treasury.
- [Tasmania unclaimed money (Treasury and Finance)](https://www.treasury.tas.gov.au/budget-and-financial-management/guidelines-instructions-and-legislation/unclaimed-money): Unclaimed money of $50 or more, published as searchable PDF listings.
- [ACT unclaimed moneys (ACT Treasury)](https://www.treasury.act.gov.au/unclaimedmoneys): Unclaimed trust monies held by ACT Treasury, including some unclaimed rental bonds.
- [Northern Territory unclaimed money (Territory Revenue Office)](https://nt.gov.au/employ/money-and-taxes/unclaimed-money/apply-for-unclaimed-money): Unclaimed company money and some NT government super benefits.
- [NSW rental bonds (Rental Bonds Online)](https://www.nsw.gov.au/housing-and-construction/renting-a-place-to-live/residential-rental-bonds/rental-bonds-online-for-tenants): Rental bonds you have not reclaimed.
- [Victoria unclaimed rental bonds (RTBA retained repayments)](https://www.consumer.vic.gov.au/housing/renting/rent-bond-bills-and-condition-reports/bond/bonds-that-have-not-been-claimed-retained-repayments): Bond repayments the RTBA couldn't pay out ('retained').

## United Kingdom (UK, currency GBP)

- [FCA Car Finance Commission Compensation Scheme](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/fca-motor-finance/): status claims open; deadline none listed; eligibility: You used finance (including HP and PCP, not PCH leasing) for a car, motorbike or van between 6 April 2007 and 1 November 2024 and weren't told about a discretionary commission arrangement, a high commission or contractual ties. Exclusions apply. Official link: https://www.fca.org.uk/consumers/car-finance-complaints
- [Post Office Capture Redress Scheme](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/post-office-capture-redress/): status claims open; deadline none listed; eligibility: Sub-postmasters (or their estates or partnerships) who suffered a financial shortfall or other harm because of the Capture accounting software. Official link: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/apply-to-the-capture-redress-scheme
- [Windrush Compensation Scheme](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/windrush-compensation/): status claims open; deadline none listed; eligibility: You suffered losses because you could not show your right to live in the UK, and you (or your parents or grandparents) came from a Commonwealth country before 1973, or you came from any country before 31 December 1988 and are now settled. Some close family members and estates can also apply. Official link: https://www.gov.uk/apply-windrush-compensation-scheme
- [Car Delivery Charges (RoRo shipping cartel) £55.8m Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/mclaren-car-delivery-charges/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: You (or your business) bought or financed a new car or van in the UK for your own use between 18 October 2006 and 6 September 2015 (some brands excluded). You can then claim for eligible new vehicles bought or leased up to 31 December 2019. Official link: https://www.cardeliverycharges.com/
- [Google Play Store UK Developers £260m Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/google-play-developers/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: UK app developers who paid Google Play commissions during the claim period (see the settlement notice). Official link: https://www.googleplaystoredeveloperclaim.com/
- [Kent v Apple App Store Overcharge Judgment](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/kent-apple-app-store/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: UK users of the App Store in the class (opt-out). Class members do not need to sign up to stay in the case. Official link: https://www.catribunal.org.uk/cases/14037721-dr-rachael-kent
- [Merricks v Mastercard £200m Consumer Settlement](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/merricks-mastercard/): status awaiting distribution; deadline none listed; eligibility: UK consumers in the class. The official site says you can register for a payment whether or not you ever held a Mastercard. Check the site for the exact class definition when claims open. Official link: https://www.mastercardconsumerclaim.co.uk/
- [British Steel Pension Scheme (BSPS) Redress Scheme](https://smilne1975.github.io/moneybackfinder-preview/uk/claims/fca-bsps-redress/): status automatic payment; deadline none listed; eligibility: You were advised to transfer out of the British Steel Pension Scheme between 26 May 2016 and 29 March 2018. Official link: https://www.fca.org.uk/consumers/british-steel-pension-redress-scheme

### Unclaimed money tools (UK)
- [My Lost Account](https://www.mylostaccount.org.uk/): Lost bank and building society accounts and NS&I products.
- [NS&I Premium Bonds prize checker](https://www.nsandi.com/prize-checker): Unclaimed Premium Bonds prizes.
- [HMRC: check how to claim a tax refund](https://www.gov.uk/claim-tax-refund): Overpaid tax on pay, job expenses (working from home, uniforms, tools), redundancy, savings interest/PPI and more.
- [Marriage Allowance (HMRC)](https://www.gov.uk/marriage-allowance): A tax cut of up to £252 a year for couples where one partner earns below the Personal Allowance.
- [Pension Tracing Service](https://www.gov.uk/find-pension-contact-details): Contact details for workplace or personal pension schemes you've lost track of.
- [Find a Child Trust Fund](https://www.gov.uk/child-trust-funds/find-a-child-trust-fund): Child Trust Funds opened for children born 1 September 2002 – 2 January 2011.
- [Unclaimed estates (Bona Vacantia)](https://www.gov.uk/unclaimed-estates-bona-vacantia): Estates of people who died without known relatives, which may be claimable by kin.
- [Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS)](https://www.fscs.org.uk/): Compensation when an authorised financial firm (bank, adviser, insurer, pension provider) has failed.
- [Financial Ombudsman Service](https://www.financial-ombudsman.org.uk/): Free, independent decisions on complaints against financial firms (e.g. car finance, BSPS) after the firm has replied.
